text:
Anya: Quick check — prepping per-customer toggle for LumenCorp. Plan: allowlist + contract gating (per their SOW), 2% prod canary for 24h, auto-rollback if error rate > 1% or latency +200ms. Posting checklist below, want a quick ack and any gaps.
Sam: LGTM. How are we mapping their contract entitlements to flags? is it org_id or account_id?
Anya: It's org_id for LumenCorp (org_5892). Contract gating will be enforced by the entitlement middleware at request-time.
Jules: Can you add a kill-switch route in the routing table? If the canary spikes we should flip to fallback model and route to dedicated-tier.
Anya: Yep — add route /flags/kill/lumencorp -> flips vip_beta to off and routes to model:open-small as fallback.
Marta: Heads up — Sales needs visibility. Can we add an alert to the onboarding slack channel when canary goes live and when it completes/rolls back?
Ryan: For metrics, monitor: 1) 5m request error rate for org_5892, 2) p95 latency delta vs baseline, 3) model token spend. Datadog monitors I suggest: rdx.request.errors.org_5892 > 1% (5m), rdx.latency.delta.p95 > 200ms (5m). I can push monitors.
Anya: Pushing the flag plan to infra PR now. CLI to toggle for rollout:
```bash
rdxctl flags set --org org_5892 --flag lumen_vip_beta --enable --canary 2 --duration 24h --owner @Anya
rdxctl flags policy attach --org org_5892 --flag lumen_vip_beta --policy contract_gate:sow_2026_lumen
```
Jules: also add a scoped rate-limit for that org during canary (e.g., 10 RPS) so their initial burst can't overwhelm caches.
Sam: Code-review ping @eng-platform — PR #3421 has the entitlement check + playbook doc. Can reviewers look for any side-effects in token accounting?
DeployBot: Deploy scheduled: infra/flags-service @ 1768882530 by Anya. CI: all green. Canary automation will run post-deploy.
Anya: Thanks — will remove the flag if anything anomalous. I'll post back here at +1h and +24h. If anyone wants access to test account credentials, DM me.
Marta: Acked. I'll notify SalesOps and include the SOW reference.
Ryan: I'll create the Datadog monitors and a dashboard tile for org_5892, and hook up webhook to #onboarding.
Jules: +1 on the scoped RL and kill-switch route. Also please add a brief rollback runbook snippet to the PR.
Anya: Added runbook snippet to PR description. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Sam: Great — I'll eyeball PR later today.
DeployBot: Canary started: 2% traffic -> org_5892 at 1768882555. Monitoring running.
Anya: Received, thanks. Anyone wants me to hold the rollout until more eyes?
